evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Exercise actual source-required native engine operations, not produce PASS reports
intent.acceptance: Source-bound provider-native invocation/completion and independently returned bytes; partial filesystem/build proof, full original requirements preserved separately

evidence.opportunity: Retained selected original run attempts, not all historical workflow activity
filters: No prose, success-job or output-existence acceptance
evidence.collection: Deterministic offline parsing of bounded original public Actions receipts and Git objects; no model calls or target code execution

model.architecture: Freeze native source-derived contracts once; independently capture, deterministically collect/score/replay
model.recommendation: Not rated: no agreed keep bar or measured costs; partial capability observations are not complete acceptance or current runtime certification
